segments.ja337:1.1: Na te pīṭhamadāyimhā [madāsimha (pī. ka.)], na pānaṃ napi bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja337:1.3: Brahmacāri khamassu me, etaṃ passāmi accayaṃ.
segments.ja337:2.1: Nevābhisajjāmi na cāpi kuppe, na cāpi me appiyamāsi kiñci;
segments.ja337:2.3: Athopi me āsi manovitakko, etādiso nūna kulassa dhammo.
